_comment: ARENCON version floor (S536). Values are service-worker cache stamps (YYYYMMDDHHMM) — the one build identifier bumped on every push, shared by every tool, and sortable. A client reads the stamp of the cache it is actually running from and compares it here. warnBelow shows an unmissable banner; blockBelow additionally refuses cloud writes while local saves continue and queue. Both fail OPEN: unreachable, malformed, or no service worker means the floor does not apply, so a connectivity problem can never masquerade as an out-of-date app. blockBelow stays at 0 until the push that retires a storage location — arming an untested floor is its own outage.
message: This app is out of date. Close it fully and reopen to update.
